'''Salmon''' is a common ⭐☆☆☆ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in cold and cool [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|saltwater]]. It is vanilla {{MCW|Raw Salmon|raw salmon}}, renamed. It cooks into [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught salmon for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
Salmon can be caught in these climate tables.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_cold.json}}</ref> <ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_cool.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|Cold saltwater]] || Frozen Ocean, Deep Frozen Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|-
| [[Fishing#Cool saltwater|Cool saltwater]] || Cold Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Raw fish can be eaten, but it heals nothing: Matcha Flavoured removes [[hunger]], and food only heals through the hearts shown on its tooltip. Cooked, it becomes [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], which heals {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|heals}}.

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Salmon|Output=Cooked Large Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Salmon|Output=Cooked Large Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Salmon|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:salmon</code>, so every large fish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_salmon.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught salmon for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Apprentice level. Only fish with the ⭐☆☆☆ rarity line, which the fishing loot tables add, are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/salmon.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for salmon under Cold Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%) and Cool Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%), unlocked by catching one after the player has obtained the almanac.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A determined fish that swims upstream fights rapids and refuses to accept that "going back" is a bad idea.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.
